title: UPI AutoPay Review
description: Stops a ₹199 plan being approved as a ₹9,999 "as presented" mandate that never ends by reading the cap, schedule, validity and merchant back against the plan before the PIN, flagging a cap far above the price, no fixed schedule, no end date, the wrong merchant and debits above the RBI PIN-free limit, with one-tap fixes to cap it at the plan price or end it in a year.
